title: Canonical abelian higher-direct-image class map
statement: For schemes $Y,S$ and a morphism $h:Y\to S$ [def-pc-scheme], a natural $p$, an abelian etale sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] [def-weil-size-convention], and an etale $U\to S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], form $A(U)$ by sheafifying the free abelian representable [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Define the canonical raw class map from derived morphisms $z:h^{-1}A(U)[0]\to F[0][p]$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] to $\Gamma(U,R^ph_*F)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] by the exact inverse-image single-functor comparison, the derived adjunction [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], zeroth homology and its single-functor comparison, the canonical shift-to-degree-$p$ identification, and evaluation at the image of the identity generator under the sheafification unit. This is the explicitly constructed map, with no choice of a comparison witness.

def abelianHigherDirectImageClass {S Y : Scheme.{v}} (h : Y ⟶ S)
    (p : ℕ) (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (U : S.Etale)
    (z : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (((h)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj ((abelianComparisonFree S).obj U)) ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(p : ℤ)⟧) :
    ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).obj
      (R+((h)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))).obj.obj (op U)
